description: Create a German e-invoice (E-Rechnung, EN 16931): a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF with embedded XML, and optionally XRechnung 3.0 XML in CII or UBL syntax. Supports invoices, credit notes and corrected invoices, reverse charge, intra-community supplies, discounts and service periods. Every result is checked with the official KoSIT validator and Mustang before it is returned; a failing invoice comes back with success=false and the failed rules instead of a file. Returns invoice_number, pdf_b64, validation_report (+ xrechnung_xml). On the hosted server https://fakturai.de/mcp this tool needs a live Fakturai API key (Authorization: Bearer) and counts against the monthly quota; free plan 50 invoices. To try it without a key, set test_mode=true: you get a marked test invoice (TESTRECHNUNG, not for sending) that passed the same checks. Keywords: E-Rechnung erstellen, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X, XRechnung, Rechnung PDF.

invoice_json.description: The invoice itself. Required: invoice_date, due_date, buyer {name, address} and at least one line {name, quantity, unit_price}. Optional: VAT categories, allowances, charges, delivery date or service period, XRechnung output (CII or UBL), credit notes and corrected invoices.

vat_category.description: VAT category (BT-151). S standard rate (default), Z zero rated, E exempt (needs vat_exemption_reasons.E), AE reverse charge § 13b UStG (needs buyer.vat_id), K intra-community supply (needs buyer.vat_id), G export outside the EU. Non-S categories default to vat_rate 0.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. "19.00" or 7. Defaults to the seller's default_vat_rate for category S and to 0 otherwise.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default DE.

buyer_reference.description: Buyer reference (BT-10), e.g. a Leitweg-ID. Required for XRechnung.

vat_id.description: Buyer VAT ID (BT-48). Required for AE and K.

vat_category.description: VAT category (BT-151). S standard rate (default), Z zero rated, E exempt (needs vat_exemption_reasons.E), AE reverse charge § 13b UStG (needs buyer.vat_id), K intra-community supply (needs buyer.vat_id), G export outside the EU. Non-S categories default to vat_rate 0.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. "19.00" or 7. Defaults to the seller's default_vat_rate for category S and to 0 otherwise.

delivery_date.description: Date of supply (BT-72). Defaults to invoice_date when neither it nor service_period is given.

document_type.description: BT-3: invoice 380 (default), credit_note 381 (Stornorechnung/Rechnungskorrektur, amounts stay positive) or corrected_invoice 384.

invoice_number.description: Invoice number (BT-1). Generated as <prefix>-<UTC timestamp> when omitted.

unit.description: UN/ECE Rec 20 unit code: C62 piece (default), HUR hour, DAY day, MON month, KGM kilogram.

vat_category.description: VAT category (BT-151). S standard rate (default), Z zero rated, E exempt (needs vat_exemption_reasons.E), AE reverse charge § 13b UStG (needs buyer.vat_id), K intra-community supply (needs buyer.vat_id), G export outside the EU. Non-S categories default to vat_rate 0.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. "19.00" or 7. Defaults to the seller's default_vat_rate for category S and to 0 otherwise.

preceding_invoice.description: The invoice being corrected (BT-25/BT-26). Required for credit_note and corrected_invoice.

end.description: Last day, on or after start.

vat_exemption_reasons.description: Exemption reason per non-S category, keyed by E, AE, K or G (BT-120 text, BT-121 code). Defaults exist for AE, K and G.

xrechnung.description: Also return xrechnung_xml (XRechnung 3.0), checked against the KoSIT XRechnung scenario. Needs buyer.buyer_reference, buyer.contact_email and seller contact_email + contact_phone. Default false.

xrechnung_syntax.description: Syntax of xrechnung_xml: cii (default) or ubl (UBL 2.1). Only with xrechnung=true.

invoice_json.title: Invoice Json

seller_profile.description: The invoice issuer (you or your customer's company). Required: name, vat_id, address, iban. The same object can be reused for every invoice.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Default DE.

bank_payee.description: Account holder name. Defaults to legal_name.

contact_email.description: Seller contact email. Required for XRechnung.

contact_phone.description: Seller contact phone. Required for XRechnung.

default_vat_rate.description: VAT rate used when a line has none. Default "19.00".

invoice_prefix.description: Prefix for generated invoice numbers. Default INV.

name.description: Display or trading name (BT-28). Also used as legal name when legal_name is missing.

seller_profile.title: Seller Profile

test_mode.description: true = free test invoice, no API key needed on https://fakturai.de/mcp: same KoSIT and Mustang checks, but marked TESTRECHNUNG in the PDF and in an invoice note, numbered TEST-..., not stored and not counted against a quota. Not valid for sending to a customer. Leave false (default) for a real invoice with a live API key.
